design: One generated home (six rooms, seed 7), the same devices (plus a motion-and-light sensor in the living room and in the office), the same automations and no residents, lives three logical days from midnight in each city x date x plan orientation, and once with no site (the assumed indoor curve every home got before). The third day is measured (WARMUP_DAYS before it: the rooms' thermal mass forgets their start): the minutes the heating runs, each room's temperature range, the daytime minutes (07:00-22:00) the living room is below DARK_LUX, when each automation first fires, and the outdoors. Weather is the recorded ERA5 (fetched once into the cache); a day not fetched falls back to clear sky and the assumed temperature curve, and the run says so.
